title: WMT24 Test Suite: Gender Resolution in Speaker-Listener Dialogue Roles

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation systems using a test suite of literary-style dialogues to measure how gender stereotypes (in character descriptions and manner of speaking) influence the grammatical gender of translated adjectives referring to speakers and listeners. The study also analyzes structural biases regarding the tendency of models to assume same-gender or opposite-gender speaker pairs in conversations.
